# SetupExtension

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.Setup` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/interaction/physics-hold/Editor/Setup/SetupExtension.cs#L34)

Setup steps a project adds to the end of "Set Up Project for VR". Subclass this anywhere in an
editor assembly and it is picked up automatically - the same way a project adds validator
checks by subclassing ValidationRule, or Scene Builder cards by subclassing ModuleInstaller.
The steps run after everything the framework does, so they can take the platform, the packages
and the project settings as already in place, and they run before the final save, so assets
they create are written out with the rest.
One rule, and it is the one that bites: [`Steps()`](/api/vrframework-core-editors-setup/SetupExtension#steps) must return the same steps in the
same order every time it is called. The runner carries its position through the script reloads
the setup causes as a plain index and rebuilds the sequence on the other side by calling this
again, so a list that changed length in between resumes at the wrong step. Decide inside a
step's own body and return early; do not decide by leaving the step out.

```csharp
public abstract class SetupExtension
```

**Inheritance:** [`object`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object) ← `SetupExtension`

**Examples**

```csharp
public class MyProjectSetup : SetupExtension
{
    public override IEnumerable<SetupStep> Steps()
    {
        yield return new SetupStep("Creating the project's own folders", CreateFolders);
    }

    private static void CreateFolders() { ... }
}
```
